senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.) regret, esp. the expression, before a court, of regret for a vow made under misapprehension.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 31b:32">Nidd. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ובח׳ תליא מילתא</he> and the case is dependent on a formal declaration (and decision by a court).
<cite ref="Nedarim 8b:3">Ned. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>שליח לחֲרָטַת אשתו</he> a deputy to declare his wife’s regret (and procure absolution).
<cite ref="Nedarim 77b:3">Ib. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>פותחין בח׳</he> the court begins with suggesting reasons for regret; a. e.
